user.title: Nashville Electric Service
user.description: Enter your NES customer portal credentials (myaccount.nespower.com). Linked service addresses will be discovered after you sign in.

account.title: Select an NES service address
account.description: Choose the account and service address whose usage data should be added to Home Assistant. You can run setup again to add another address.

reconfigure.title: Rediscover NES service addresses
reconfigure.description: Home Assistant could not retrieve the service addresses. Submit to try again.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with NES
reauth_confirm.description: Your NES credentials have expired. Please re-enter them.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to NES. Please try again later.
error.no_service_locations: No electric services were found for this NES login.
error.account_unavailable: The selected NES account or service address is no longer available to this login.

abort.already_configured: This NES service address is already configured.
abort.no_service_locations: No electric services were found for this NES login.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The NES service address was updated successfully.
